metadata.description: Claude Code skills for Cognitive Tours: start a map of an unfamiliar repo, then record and check your own understanding as waypoints and tours.

plugins.name: cognitive-tours
plugins.description: Five skills for a Cognitive Tours map: first-tours drafts a starting map of an unfamiliar repo; suggest-waypoint and suggest-tour add your recent work to the map and leave the writing to you; audit-waypoints and audit-tours check the map against the code.
